test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

To avoid indigetion, it is necessary to chew food properly.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"indigetion"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"indigestion"** which means discomfort or pain in the stomach associated with difficulty in digesting food. (अजीर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **He often suffers from indigestion after eating spicy food.
 
 
 
• **Indigestion** refers to the condition where one experiences discomfort or pain in the stomach after eating. (अजीर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **To avoid** indigestion**, doctors recommend eating smaller meals.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Indigestion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Necessary** (आवश्यक): Required to be done, achieved, or present; needed.

 
 
• **Example:** It is necessary to exercise regularly for good health.
 
 
 
• **Properly** (ठीक से): In a way that is correct and appropriate.
 
 
• **Example:** Ensure you dress properly for the interview.
 
 
 
• **Chew** (चबाना): Bite and work food in the mouth with the teeth, especially to make it easier to swallow.
 
 
• **Example:** Remember to chew your food slowly and carefully.
